Otech strengthens locally hosted cybersecurity services through a new collaboration with Kaspersky. Otech has become an authorised Kaspersky managed security service provider partner in Oman, the companies said at a security exhibition in Dubai. Under the agreement, Otech will offer Kaspersky's protection products from its own in-country data centre, supported by round-the-clock security operations staff. A Kaspersky executive said organisations increasingly want control over where their security data is stored and processed, and that the arrangement supports data sovereignty requirements. The chairman of Otech's parent company described the agreement as a step towards expanding the group's presence in Oman and building a stronger local cybersecurity ecosystem. Otech is the technology arm of Omantel.
